hints.title: Weekly Deposit Pattern
hints.text: The first week earns 1 through 7, totaling 28. Each subsequent week increases every daily deposit by 1.

hints.title: Full Weeks Arithmetic Series
hints.text: Week w contributes 28 + 7 * w. Summing full weeks forms an arithmetic progression.

hints.title: Add Remaining Partial Days
hints.text: For the remaining n % 7 days of week full_weeks, deposits start at full_weeks + 1 and increment by 1 daily.

hints.title: Full Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def totalMoney(self, n: int) -> int:
        weeks = n // 7
        rem = n % 7
        total_weeks = 28 * weeks + 7 * (weeks * (weeks - 1) // 2)
        rem_sum = rem * (weeks + 1) + rem * (rem - 1) // 2
        return total_weeks + rem_sum
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Looping day by day takes O(n) time, whereas a closed-form formula runs in O(1).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Direct arithmetic series calculation computes the total in constant time and space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate utilizes closed-form arithmetic progression formulas.
